vot_greeter: Farseer Nakhtar. This is the Valley of Trials - every recruit the Horde takes starts on this ridge, and lately so does everyone who wakes up here with sand in their mouth and no idea why. I decide when you're ready for Durotar. Until then, I have work.
vot_guard_1: I hold the camp road. Boars west, scorpids east, and a cave full of demons past the scorpids that nobody's given me the swords to clear. If you're looking for something to hit, I know where it is.
vot_elder: Kuraw. I've taught this valley's recruits longer than Nakhtar's been talking to them. He'll tell you what the Horde is. I'll show you the Den, the dunes and the burnt ground, and you'll learn it faster.
vot_recruit_watcher: Grulnok. Six seasons on this ridge, watching the tracks. The boars keep to Sagebrush Flat, west of camp - all but one, and that one's been walking through the training dummies like they owe him something.
vot_goblin_tinkerer: Fizzcrank Sprocketspin, independent researcher, currently attached to this camp because the camp has not asked me to leave. Don't touch the bench. It isn't finished, and part of it may be slightly on fire.
vot_orc_mother: Rhaka. My son's one of the recruits - he went up the ridge last week and came back, and I mean to keep it that way. I weave. If you're going into the Den for any reason, talk to me first.
vot_wounded_grunt: Torgak. A scorpid opened my leg at the nest before I put it down. Nakhtar says I'll walk again and I believe him more than I believe the leg. Until then I sit here and watch the vultures take an interest.
vot_skeleton_curiosity: [A skeleton, upright, at the edge of camp. It does not move and it does not speak. Nobody here put it there, and nobody has been willing to be the one who takes it down.]
vot_young_orc: Grosk. The Younger - my father's the other one. I've killed more boars on this ridge than anyone my age and I'm not leaving the valley until I've got something better than a boar to show for it.
ct_vot: Garrek. I train whatever you turned out to be - blade, bow, spell, it's all the same job from where I stand. Show me where you've got to and bring coin; the lessons aren't charity.
pt_vot_forge: Brakka. I teach mining here: where to dig and how to tell ore from rock. The camp forge is north of me, by the Farseer's tent, for smelting what you bring back. Smithing proper is taught in Razor Hill.
pt_vot_herbs: Shazra. I teach herbalism - which plant to pull and which to leave in the ground. Brewing them is alchemy, and that wants a bench and a roof. Apothecary Kagra has both in Razor Hill.
pt_vot_wood: Bruga. I teach woodcutting: fell it clean, strip it properly, don't cut the same log twice. The camp sawmill is north-west of here, past Marta's fire, for turning logs into planks. Building with the planks is woodworking - Woodwright Hulda teaches that in Razor Hill.
